verdict.rationale: MX documents a test platform offering four test institutions, free developer API keys, and guidance on testing the Connect Widget, including OAuth flows. That covers the core of exercising linking and data retrieval before using a real bank account. missing for 10: documented test credentials for the test institutions, documented simulation of error states (e.g., failed logins, MFA, institution downtime), independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox.
